request.project_task: Build a personal data export request workflow.
request.project_goal: Fulfil verified export requests within a controlled process.
request.project_description: A user requests an export, verifies identity, and downloads a time-limited archive assembled from multiple services.

functional_requirements.text: A user requests an export of personal data.

atoms.text: A user requests an export of personal data.

functional_requirements.text: The system requires recent identity verification.

atoms.text: The system requires recent identity verification.

functional_requirements.text: The system collects data from registered source services.

atoms.text: The system collects data from registered source services.

functional_requirements.text: The system records unavailable sources without silently omitting them.

atoms.text: The system records unavailable sources without silently omitting them.

functional_requirements.text: The system creates an encrypted archive.

atoms.text: The system creates an encrypted archive.

functional_requirements.text: The system sends a time-limited download notification.

atoms.text: The system sends a time-limited download notification.

functional_requirements.text: The user downloads the archive after re-authentication.

atoms.text: The user downloads the archive after re-authentication.

functional_requirements.text: The archive is deleted after expiry.

atoms.text: The archive is deleted after expiry.

non_functional_requirements.text: The export process must complete within the legal service deadline.
Archive links must be single-user and time-limited.
Audit records must exclude archive content.

actors.name: Data Subject
actors.description: The user who requests and downloads an export of their personal data.

actors.name: Identity Verification Service
actors.description: External service that verifies the identity of the data subject.

actors.name: Source Service
actors.description: Registered service that holds personal data and provides it for export.

actors.name: Notification Service
actors.description: Service that delivers the time-limited download notification.

use_cases.name: Request Personal Data Export
use_cases.goal: Allow a data subject to request an export of their personal data.
use_cases.trigger: The data subject initiates an export request.

success_postconditions.text: An export request is recorded and identity verification is confirmed.

failure_postconditions.text: The export request is rejected because identity verification is not recent.

steps.action: The data subject requests an export of personal data.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the export request.

steps.action: The system requires recent identity verification.
steps.expected_result: The system checks whether identity verification is recent.

steps.expected_result: The system accepts the export request.

steps.action: The system determines that identity verification is not recent.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the export request.

user_stories.capability: request an export of my personal data
user_stories.benefit: I can obtain a copy of my personal data

system_stories.system_action: Require recent identity verification before accepting an export request.
system_stories.responsibility: Enforce identity verification recency for export requests.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Personal Data Export
Goal: Allow a data subject to request an export of their personal data.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The data subject initiates an export request.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The data subject is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] The data subject requests an export of personal data.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] The system requires recent identity verification.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The identity verification service confirms recent identity verification.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Identity verification not recent
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Assemble and Deliver Personal Data Export
use_cases.goal: Collect data from source services, create an encrypted archive, and deliver a time-limited download notification.
use_cases.trigger: An export request has been accepted.

preconditions.text: An export request has been accepted.

success_postconditions.text: An encrypted archive is created and a time-limited download notification is sent.

failure_postconditions.text: The export process fails and the failure is recorded.

steps.action: The system collects data from registered source services.
steps.expected_result: Data is collected from available source services.

steps.action: The system records unavailable sources without silently omitting them.
steps.expected_result: Unavailable sources are recorded in the export result.

steps.action: The system creates an encrypted archive.
The system sends a time-limited download notification.
steps.expected_result: The data subject receives a time-limited download notification.

user_stories.capability: receive a time-limited download notification for my export
user_stories.benefit: I can download my personal data archive

system_stories.system_action: Collect data from registered source services and record unavailable sources.
system_stories.responsibility: Assemble export data while preserving source availability information.

system_stories.system_action: Create an encrypted archive and send a time-limited download notification.
system_stories.responsibility: Package and deliver the export securely.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Assemble and Deliver Personal Data Export
Goal: Collect data from source services, create an encrypted archive, and deliver a time-limited download notification.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: An export request has been accepted.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: An export request has been accepted.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] The system collects data from registered source services.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The system records unavailable sources without silently omitting them.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] The system creates an encrypted archive.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] The system sends a time-limited download notification.
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006

use_cases.name: Download Personal Data Archive
use_cases.goal: Allow the data subject to download the encrypted archive after re-authentication.
use_cases.trigger: The data subject opens the time-limited download notification.

preconditions.text: A time-limited download notification has been sent.

success_postconditions.text: The data subject downloads the encrypted archive.

failure_postconditions.text: The download fails because re-authentication is not successful.

steps.action: The user downloads the archive after re-authentication.
The system determines that re-authentication is not successful.

user_stories.capability: download my personal data archive after re-authentication
user_stories.benefit: I can access my exported personal data

system_stories.system_action: Require re-authentication before allowing archive download.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Download Personal Data Archive
Goal: Allow the data subject to download the encrypted archive after re-authentication.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The data subject opens the time-limited download notification.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: A time-limited download notification has been sent.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] The user downloads the archive after re-authentication.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Re-authentication fails
Source FRs: FR-007

use_cases.name: Expire and Delete Personal Data Archive
use_cases.trigger: The archive expiry time is reached.

success_postconditions.text: The archive is deleted after expiry.

steps.action: The archive is deleted after expiry.
steps.expected_result: The archive is no longer available.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Expire and Delete Personal Data Archive
Goal: Delete the archive after expiry.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The archive expiry time is reached.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: An encrypted archive exists.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] The archive is deleted after expiry.
Source FRs: FR-008
